title: Meeting highlights from the Pharmacovigilance Risk Assessment Committee (PRAC) 8-11 April 2024: GLP-1 receptor agonists, available evidence not supporting link with suicidal and self-injurious thoughts and actions
authors: European Medicines Agency, Pharmacovigilance Risk Assessment Committee
result: PRAC concluded that available evidence does not support a causal association between dulaglutide, exenatide, liraglutide, lixisenatide or semaglutide and suicidal and self-injurious thoughts and actions. The review began in July 2023 after case reports with liraglutide and semaglutide; in November 2023 the committee requested data from the marketing authorisation holders. It analysed an electronic health record study of semaglutide and suicidal ideation (Wang et al., Nature Medicine 2024) and an EMA-conducted electronic health record study of suicide-related and self-injury events in type 2 diabetes, neither of which supported a causal association.
